findings.title: Partial release: some packages publish via OIDC, others fail, leaving published dependents pinned to unpublished sibling versions
findings.label: valid
findings.note: A partial release with dependents (drizzle->schema/protect, cli->stack/migrate) pinned to unpublished siblings is plausible once NPM_TOKEN is removed; the cited lines are accurate.

findings.title: Unpinned npm@^11.5.1 is fetched into the job that can mint npm publish credentials
findings.label: valid
findings.note: The new unpinned npm range runs in the OIDC-capable release job, and the cited permissions and install step are accurate.

findings.title: First post-merge release fails closed because the OIDC path is not actually used by changesets/pnpm
findings.label: unsupported
findings.note: Speculation that the OIDC path is not used; the finding admits the changesets/action and pnpm behavior was not verified, and nothing in the cited code shows the failure.
